target_customer: In 2022, cross border families wanting joint and savings accounts built on digital assets; by 2025, corporate finance and accounting teams at large companies
problem: In 2022 Finnt targeted families spread across countries who struggle to send, save and spend money together. By September 2025 it sold AI agents that run controllership and accounting procedures and deliver ERP ready journals with an audit trail.
business_model: Consumer fintech on blockchain rails in 2022; enterprise AI agent software by 2025, pricing not found
product_category: Cross border family finance app, later AI agents for corporate finance

founders.name: Anji Ismail
prior_employers: Welcome (Director of Product; later acquired by Optimizely)
previous_startups: DOZ (marketing SaaS, co-founded with El Yagoubi)
founders.background_notes: Also a former angel investor. Source: Refresh Miami, June 8 2022.

founders.name: Faouzi El Yagoubi
founders.background_notes: Listed as Founder on the YC page. Source: Refresh Miami and YC company page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A 2022 consumer app with joint accounts on blockchain rails needs custody, compliance and onramps; the 2025 agent product is applied LLM engineering with ERP integration and audit trail.

defensibility.rationale: No exclusive data or licenses described in sources for either product. Compliance or integration depth could help the 2025 product, but only a press release was found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying was found. The company survived by changing product.

market_need_then: ISAI and Refresh Miami describe a market of globally distributed families needing shared money tools, but no demand figures were cited. The pivot to finance AI agents suggests the original consumer need did not hold, though no source states why.

branding.domain_note: Uses finnt.com per directory profiles; acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: not described in any reliable source
identity.voice_and_tone: Enterprise and compliance oriented in the 2025 press release (SOC 2, Excel auditability).

branding.community_and_virality: No community, merch or press on the brand itself found; it is also confused with other fintech names such as Finn and Fynt in search.

brand_strength.rationale: A compressed finance word coinage that is easy to misspell and similar to many fintech names, with no brand coverage found.

pivots.from: Global joint and savings accounts for distributed families on blockchain rails
pivots.to: AI agents for corporate finance and accounting teams
pivots.why: Not stated in sources. The 2022 seed announcements describe the family product; the September 2025 press release describes AI agents.

outcome_analysis: Finnt raised a 3.5 million dollar seed in May 2022 for a blockchain based family finance app, then by 2025 described itself as an AI agent company for corporate finance, with Fortune 500 customers claimed on LinkedIn. YC marks it Inactive, but it appears to be operating under a changed product, so the Inactive label likely reflects the YC directory and not a shutdown. The pivot date and reasons are not public.
notes: The website fetch of finnt.com returned 404. The 3.5M seed is confirmed by two outlets (ISAI release dated May 11 without year, Refresh Miami June 8 2022). One aggregator lists total funding of 7M dollars and another a 2.9M seed plus 0.6M pre-seed; unreconciled, so not recorded. No competitor source dated near the batch was found, and the batch description (AI agents) is from the later pivot. YC launch post not found. Pivot date is the year of the press release. Company is marked Inactive by YC but appears active, so exit is none. Funding for later years was not found.
